title: Coefficient naturality of canonical Ext evaluation
statement: For any scheme X and morphism φ:F→G of abelian etale sheaves [def-pc-scheme,def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], every q and Ext class x, the specified evaluation sheafHToDerived [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-presentation,def-weil-pbc-derived-ext-evaluation] of Sheaf.H.map φ q x equals the map on derived cohomology of the single-complex coefficient morphism applied to the evaluation of x.

proof.text: Ext postcomposition represents postcomposition by the shifted single map. In an abstract abelian category, form the natural composite of the right-derived shift comparison, homology shift comparison and single-complex comparison. Evaluate its naturality at the image of x applied to the fixed degree-zero generator. Functoriality of composition gives precisely the two evaluation composites. Specialize to etale sheaves.
